title: LR Meta-Calibration Layer for Sub-0.21 Brier — Two-Stage Prediction Pipeline

source_research.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
source_research.key_finding: Logistic Regression attains best Brier score (0.199) and log-loss among tabular baselines. XGBoost achieves 0.202 Brier but higher AUC.

source_research.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
source_research.key_finding: Stacked ensembles with LR meta-learner outperform individual boosting models by 1.5-2% Brier score

hypothesis: Adding a logistic regression calibration layer on top of existing GA-selected XGBoost/RF/CatBoost models could push Brier from 0.22066 toward 0.199. LR excels at calibration because it optimizes log-loss (equivalent to calibration), while tree models optimize rank-based metrics and produce poorly calibrated probabilities.

stage_2.training: Isotonic or sigmoid via CalibratedClassifierCV, selected by held-out Brier loss
stage_2.clipping: [0.025, 0.975] — prevents catastrophic Brier from extreme predictions

files_to_modify: hf-space/app.py — wrap predict() with LR calibration layer
features/engine.py — no changes needed (Cat34 already has ensemble meta-features)
implementation.cpu_cost: LR is O(n) inference — zero performance impact on HF Spaces

implementation_code_sketch.note: Add to hf-space/app.py predict() function after base model prediction
implementation_code_sketch.snippet:
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
# Stage 2: LR calibration
cal_features = np.column_stack([p_base, market_prob, home_elo_adj, form_delta, rest_diff])
cal_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(LogisticRegression(C=1.0), cv=5, method='isotonic')
cal_model.fit(cal_features, y_train)  # fit on recent 3-season sliding window
p_final = np.clip(cal_model.predict_proba(cal_features_test)[:, 1], 0.025, 0.975)

validation.metric: Walk-forward Brier score (19 weeks, 934 games — identical to Kaggle setup)

risk: LOW — LR layer can only improve or maintain calibration, cannot degrade base model accuracy. Reverting is instant.
cross_repo_port: Same technique applies to nomos-political-alpha (Cat3 market features → LR meta-calibration). Political brier currently 0.24186 — could target 0.22.
